findings.text: the published document has no production reader at this head: reckon/cli.py:964 and reckon/mcp.py:3497 both pass windows=recorded_windows(...) and name no document or document_path, so nothing in production paces from the document and the plan's "Preflight and dispatch read that document" is false live; it is outside this node's fence and is carried as a follow-on.

the landed paragraph, and the same clause at docs/evidence/archive/the-local-lane-is-the-default-landed.html:61, still describes the pre-repair contract -- the pre-flight takes its figures from the document "when the caller supplies no reading of its own" -- where at this head the caller must also name the document, so the sentence under-specifies the interface the follow-on wiring in cli.py and mcp.py has to satisfy.
--help and -h are accepted by the parser and discarded, so the documented command run with --help publishes a document instead of printing usage.
